experiment: 026-final-run/r2r3: R2 (mechanism: manipulations) and R3 (laundering stress map) of docs/11-final-run-plan.md (D-020). All constants below fixed before any real-data result was produced.
feature_layout: per block: [CLS(768) | mean-patch(768)] = 1536 dims; array [N, 12, 1536]; block b -> index b-1 (hidden_states[b], pre final LayerNorm, as 004)
small_image_rule: if the laundered image has a short side < 224 (resize factors 0.35, 0.25 of the 512 crop), bicubic-upsample it so the short side is 224 before the centre crop (identical for all classes). Cells with factor >= 0.5 use the plain centre crop exactly as the 004 pipeline.
tiebreak: inner-CV bacc ties -> lower block index, then smaller C

manipulations.none: unmanipulated 224 crop (reference; blocks 4/8/12 must reproduce the 004 cache)
manipulations.a_shuffle: 32x32 tile shuffle of the 224 crop: 49 tiles, permutation from default_rng(seed_from_key('tileshuffle:'+sha256, 0)); same permutation for every condition of an image
manipulations.b_blur: Gaussian blur sigma=1.5 px (scipy gaussian_filter, spatial axes, mode reflect, truncate 4), rounded to uint8
manipulations.d_gray: PIL convert('L') (ITU-R 601 luma) replicated to 3 channels

pred_r2.mid_over_last_persists: paired bootstrap CI lower bound of [bacc(nested best mid block) - bacc(block 12)] under (a) > 0

r2_primary_numerator: nested-mid: per outer fold choose the block among mid_blocks (and C) by inner grouped CV on TRAIN folds only (T-mix training, scored at sel_cond), under the same manipulation
r2_retained_def: (bacc_manip - 1/8) / (bacc_none - 1/8) with both from nested-mid at the primary condition; sensitivity: fixed block B* (best mid block of the unmanipulated profile at the primary, oracle) and per-manipulation oracle best mid block
r2_verdict_rule: point estimate decides confirmed/refuted; 'CI-robust' if the 95% bootstrap CI lies entirely on the same side of the threshold

grid.cell_condition: jr(q,f) = jpeg(resize(img,f),q); f=1.0 means JPEG only (lib/perturb.apply_condition)

extended_interpretation: docs/11 'adds q45 and resize 0.35': one new training cell on each axis through the training point (q75,f0.5): q45 at f0.5 and f0.35 at q75. Train only; test images are never in training.

pred_r3.smooth_decay: frozen probe: max single-step bacc drop along any grid axis slice <= 0.20 (cliff otherwise); non-monotone rises > 0.05 are counted and reported
pred_r3.shift_rule: per axis slice (5 resize rows scanning quality, 6 quality columns scanning resize): breaking index = first step (from the mild end) with bacc < 0.5, grid length if none; shift = ext - frozen; headline = median shift over slices where at least one probe breaks; confirmed if >= 1

guards.d008_tol: max(1e-3, 2 x CPU run-to-run spread), applied to the scaled feature diff and to the probe decision-logit diff
